requirements.text: The system should allow students to manage loans online, including borrowing and returning items, and viewing due dates.
The system should automatically calculate fines and display outstanding fines in student accounts.
There should be a way for librarians to intervene in disputes regarding fines.
The system should enable students to book study rooms online, selecting date, time, and number of users.
The system should show real-time availability of study rooms to prevent overbooking.
There should be a way for librarians to oversee bookings and handle any special requests or conflicts.
